sloka: क्षुद्रेण पापेन नृशम्स कर्मणा ।सुदारुण अलाम्कृत वेष धारिणा।बल अभिभूता अबला तपस्विनी ।कथम् नु मे दृष्ट पथे अद्य सा भवेत् ॥५-१३-६९॥
transliteration: kṣudreṇa pāpena nṛśamsa karmaṇā ।sudāruṇa alāmkṛta veṣa dhāriṇā।bala abhibhūtā abalā tapasvinī ।katham nu me dṛṣṭa pathe adya sā bhavet ॥5-13-69॥

translations.english: "How will I set my eyes on that gentle, frail and suffering thing now, who has been abducted by that mean, cruel sinner of dreadful look?" इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
